title: Modernize ingest fanout and tokenizer negotiation proxy
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Background: Over the last 24 months the model ingest pipeline has accreted several ad-hoc sharding and tokenizer handoff behaviors. This has led to long tail model load latency, brittle format detection, and duplication in manifest interpretation across loaders. Goal: Reduce model load tail by ~30% for multi-shard checkpoints, remove tokenizer initialization duplication, and provide a stable, explicit tokenizer negotiation proxy that isolates tokenizer contracts from shard activation semantics. Scope: refactor fanout/shard-mapper, introduce deferred activation proxy that performs preflight checks and KV-prefetch hints, extract tokenizer handshake into a single stable interface and implement a small adapter layer for legacy checkpoint formats. This ticket covers API, runtime integration, tests, migration script, and rollout plan for runtime-1.20.
acceptance_criteria: New TokenizerNegotiationProxy API implemented and unit-tested
Shard fanout moved to ingest-fanout service with clear boundary and contract tests
End-to-end model load time for a 16-shard 30B model reduced by >=25% on staging
No changes required in customer-facing model manifest format (backwards-compatible adapters added)
Canary rollout plan executed with metrics showing no regression in successful loads (>=99% success)
Documentation and migration notes published: Confluence + changelog entry
technical_notes: Key design decisions: 1) Introduce an ingest-fanout service that receives a normalized checkpoint manifest and returns per-shard activation tickets; 2) TokenizerNegotiationProxy handles vocab/hash/version checks and exposes stable session tokens for shard bootstrap; 3) DeferredActivationProxy defers heavyweight weight deserialization until preflight checks and KV cache hints are accepted; 4) Legacy checkpoint adapters implement a small shim to produce canonical manifests (protobuf v2->v3 mapping). Performance work will focus on overlapping tokenizer init with network fetches and early KV warmups.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 sprint): implement TokenizerNegotiationProxy and canonical manifest translator; add unit + integration tests. Phase 2 (1 sprint): extract fanout to ingest-fanout service, wire DeferredActivationProxy and preflight hinting API; add load benchmarking harness. Phase 3 (1 sprint): run staging canary across representative models, address regressions, publish docs and migration script. Final step: controlled rollout to 10% runtime traffic then 100%.
risks: Adapter mistakes could mislabel tokenizer versions leading to subtle generation drift
Race conditions between deferred activation and runtime eviction if preflight delays are long
Uncaught manifest edge cases for exotic checkpoint formats (custom shards, crypto-signed manifests)
Upgrading protobuf runtime may impact other services if transitive dependencies are not pinned
testing_plan: Unit tests for TokenizerNegotiationProxy and manifest translator. Integration tests between ingest-fanout and shard workers using the load harness. Performance benchmarks comparing baseline and refactor on staging infra (same GPU types). Add synthetic failure tests: partial shard failures, tokenization mismatch, corrupted manifest. Monitoring: per-step timing spans (manifest-parse, tokenizer-negotiation, per-shard-activation, weight-deser) and success/failure counters. Rollback criteria defined in rollout doc.
